directory.heading: Items
directory.lede: The goods this warehouse deals in. A SKU identifies one item inside this warehouse and nowhere else — the same SKU in another warehouse names an unrelated item.

footer.note: An inactive item keeps its SKU and keeps counting on every record that already names it.

note.heading: A SKU is correctable only until something names its item
note.body: Once a customer order or a purchase draft line names an item, its SKU is fixed for the life of that item — the description and the unit it is counted in stay correctable. Deactivating an item never releases its SKU for reuse.

empty.heading: This warehouse deals in nothing yet
empty.description: An item is what demand and a draft line both name, so it is the first thing to add. Give it a SKU that is unused here and the unit its quantities are counted in.

row.none: Nothing names it yet — its SKU is still correctable

card.none: Counted in {{unit}} · nothing names it yet, so its SKU is still correctable

naming.inactive: {{naming}} · no longer offered when demand or a draft is assembled

create.title: Add an item
create.lede: It belongs to this warehouse alone. The same SKU in another warehouse names an unrelated item.
create.descriptionHelp: What the good is, in the words your team uses.
create.unitOfMeasureHelp: Pieces, metres, kilograms or litres. Every quantity naming this item is read this way.
create.note: A new item starts active with nothing on hand.

correct.title: Correct {{sku}} · {{description}}
correct.skuHelp: Correctable only while nothing names this item.
correct.descriptionHelp: Still correctable — as is the unit it is counted in.
correct.note: An item that nothing yet names may still have its SKU corrected, to any SKU unused in this warehouse. Deactivating an item never releases its SKU either.

adjustOnHand.title: Set the on-hand quantity
adjustOnHand.lede: State the count you have just made — never an increase or a decrease.
adjustOnHand.quantityHelp: A whole number that is never negative.
adjustOnHand.reasonHelp: Required. Recorded with your name and the time, so a figure that drifts can be explained.
adjustOnHand.note: Nothing else in Warehouser changes this figure — confirming an arrival does not touch it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{sku}} · {{description}}?
deactivate.lede: It stops being offered when demand is recorded and when a draft is assembled.

naming.both: The {{orders}} and {{lines}} that already name it stay readable and keep counting exactly as before.
naming.orders: The {{orders}} that already name it stay readable and keep counting exactly as before.
naming.lines: The {{lines}} that already name it stay readable and keep counting exactly as before.
naming.none: Nothing names it yet, so no record changes.

deactivate.skuStaysTaken: Its SKU stays taken — no new item may reuse it.
deactivate.reversible: You can make it active again at any time.

refusal.unavailable: This item is no longer available in this warehouse, so nothing has changed.
refusal.archived: This warehouse has been archived, so nothing it holds can be changed.
refusal.invalid: Some of what you entered was not accepted, and nothing has changed.
